fields.headline: NCIA Investigating Flight Information Display Issue; Airport Remains Safe and Open
fields.subhead: Travelers should confirm gate and departure times with their airline before going to the gate
fields.body:
Northeast Central Interstate Airport (NCIA) is investigating a technical issue affecting the flight information display screens in the terminal. Some screens are showing incorrect gate and departure information. The airport has switched to manual operations and staff are directing passengers at every concourse.

There is no threat to aircraft, the control tower or the terminal. Reports circulating on social media that the control tower has been taken over are false. Air traffic control is operating normally under the Federal Aviation Administration.

"Our first priority is getting every traveler to the right gate safely," said the Airport Director. "We are working with our airline partners and technology vendors to restore accurate information as quickly as possible, and we will share updates as we confirm them."

Passengers should check their airline's app or website, or ask an airline agent, for current gate and departure information. Customer service representatives are stationed at the central atrium and at the entrance to each concourse.

The next update will be issued at 1:00 PM.
fields.boilerplate: Northeast Central Interstate Airport serves more than 10 million passengers a year with nonstop service to over 50 destinations. NCIA is operated by the Northeast Central Airport Authority.
